# Unlinked Typography & Font Suites

This directory contains the custom typography suites and icon glyph assets for **Unlinked External** and the **Unlinked UI Framework**.

---

## 1. Supported Typography Families

### Poppins (Clean Curved Sans-Serif)
- `Poppins-Regular.ttf`
- `Poppins-Medium.ttf`
- `Poppins-SemiBold.ttf`

### Inter (Modern Sleek UI Standard)
- `Inter-Regular.ttf`
- `Inter-Medium.ttf`
- `Inter-SemiBold.ttf`

### JetBrains Mono (Developer & Code Display)
- `JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf`
- `JetBrainsMono-Medium.ttf`
- `JetBrainsMono-SemiBold.ttf`

### Outfit (Geometric Modern Display)
- `Outfit-Regular.ttf`
- `Outfit-Medium.ttf`
- `Outfit-SemiBold.ttf`

### Montserrat (Sleek Clean Display)
- `Montserrat-Regular.ttf`
- `Montserrat-Medium.ttf`
- `Montserrat-SemiBold.ttf`

---

## 2. Icon Glyphs (Font Awesome 6 Free)
- `fa-solid-900.woff2` — High-contrast solid icon markers
- `fa-regular-400.woff2` — Regular UI outline icons
- `fa-brands-400.woff2` — Brand icons and platform markers
